section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Description
text: Identifies the removal, biopsy, or aspiration of regional lymph node(s) at the time of surgery of the primary site or during a separate surgical event at this facility.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: The scope of regional lymph node surgery is collected for each surgical event even if surgery of the primary site was not performed.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: If a surgical procedure which aspirates, biopsies, or removes regional lymph nodes to diagnose or stage this cancer, record the scope of regional lymph nodes surgery in this data item. Record the date of this surgical procedure in data item Date of First Course of Treatment [1270] and/or Date of First Surgical Procedure [1200] as appropriate (excluding code 1).

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Record the date of this procedure in Date of Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy [832] and/or Date Regional Lymph Node Dissection [682], if applicable.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Codes 0-7 are hierarchical. If only one procedure can be recorded, code the procedure that is numerically higher.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: If two or more surgical procedures of regional lymph nodes are performed, the codes entered in the registry for each subsequent procedure must include the cumulative effect of all preceding procedures. For example, a sentinel lymph node biopsy followed by a regional lymph node dissection at a later time is coded 7. Do not rely on registry software to determine the cumulative code.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Code 9 for: Any Schema ID with primary site: C420, C421, C423, C424, C589, C700-C709, C710-C729, C751-C753, C761-C768, C770-C779, C809

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Do not code distant lymph nodes removed during surgery to the primary site for this data item. They are coded in the data field Surgical Procedure/Other Site [1294].

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Refer to the current AJCC Cancer Staging Manual for site-specific identification of regional lymph nodes.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: If the procedure coded in this item was provided to prolong a patient's life by controlling symptoms, to alleviate pain, or to make the patient more comfortable, then also record this surgery in the item Palliative Care at This Facility [3280].

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Use the operative report as the primary source document to determine whether the operative procedure was a sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNBx), or a more extensive dissection of regional lymph nodes, or a combination of both SLNBx and regional lymph node dissection. The operative report will designate the surgeon's planned procedure as well as a description of the procedure that was actually performed. The pathology report may be used to complement the information appearing in the operative report, but the operative report takes precedence when attempting to distinguish between SLNBx and regional lymph node dissection or a combination of these two procedures.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Do not use the number of lymph nodes removed and pathologically examined as the sole means of distinguishing between a SLNBx and a regional lymph node dissection.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text:
0 No regional lymph node surgery
1 Biopsy or aspiration of regional lymph node(s)
2 Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy
3 Number of regional lymph nodes removed unknown or not stated; regional lymph nodes removed, NOS
4 1-3 regional lymph nodes removed
5 4 or more regional lymph nodes removed
6 Sentinel node biopsy and code 3, 4, or 5 at same time, or timing not stated
7 Sentinel node biopsy and code 3, 4, or 5 at different times
9 Unknown or not applicable

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Use the operative report as the primary source document to determine whether the operative procedure was a sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNBx), an axillary lymph node dissection (ALND), or a combination of both SLNBx and ALND. The operative report will designate the surgeon's planned procedure as well as a description of the procedure that was actually performed. The pathology report may be used to complement the information appearing in the operative report, but the operative report takes precedence when attempting to distinguish between SLNBx and ALND, or a combination of these two procedures.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Do not use the number of lymph nodes removed and pathologically examined as the sole means of distinguishing between a SLNBx and an ALND.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Review the operative report to confirm whether an excisional biopsy or aspiration of regional lymph nodes was actually performed, and it did not include the use of dye or tracer for a SLNBx procedure (code 2). If additional procedures were performed on the lymph nodes, use the appropriate code 2-7.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Excisional biopsy or aspiration of regional lymph nodes for breast cancer is uncommon. Review the operative report to confirm whether an excisional biopsy or aspiration of regional lymph nodes was actually performed; it is highly possible that the procedure is a SLNBx (code 2) instead. If additional procedures were performed on the lymph nodes, such as axillary lymph node dissection, use the appropriate code 2-7.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Code 2 SLNBx when the operative report describes a procedure using injection of a dye, radio label, or combination to identify a lymph node (possibly more than one) for removal/examination.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: When a SLNBx is performed, additional non-sentinel nodes can be taken during the same operative procedure. These additional non-sentinel nodes are palpably abnormal and selectively removed (or harvested) as part of the SLNBx procedure by the surgeon or may be discovered by the pathologist. Code this as a SLNBx (code 2).

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: If review of the operative report confirms that a regional lymph node dissection followed the SLNBx, code these cases as 6.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: If a relatively large number of lymph nodes, more than 5, are pathologically examined, review the operative report to confirm the procedure was limited to a SLNBx and did not include an axillary lymph node dissection (ALND).

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Patients undergoing SLNBx who fail to map will often undergo ALND. Code these cases as 2 if no ALND was performed, or 6 when ALND was performed during the same operative event.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Enter the appropriate number of nodes examined and positive in the data items Regional Lymph Nodes Examined [830] and Regional Lymph Nodes Positive [820].

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: The operative report states that a regional lymph node dissection was performed (a SLNBx was not done during this procedure or in a prior procedure). Code 3 (Number of regional lymph nodes removed unknown, not stated; regional lymph nodes removed, NOS). Check the operative report to ensure this procedure is not a SLNBx only (code 2), or a SLNBx with a regional lymph node dissection (code 6 or 7).

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Code 4 (1-3 regional lymph nodes removed) should be used infrequently. Review the operative report to ensure the procedure was not a SLNBx only.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Code 5 (4 or more regional lymph nodes removed). If a relatively small number of nodes was examined pathologically, review the operative report to confirm the procedure was not a SLNBx only (code 2). If a relatively large number of nodes was examined pathologically, review the operative report to confirm that there was not a SLNBx in addition to a more extensive regional lymph node dissection during the same, or separate, procedure (code 6 or 7).

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: Infrequently, a SLNBx is attempted and the patient fails to map (i.e. no sentinel lymph nodes are identified by the dye and/or radio label injection). When mapping fails, surgeons usually perform a more extensive dissection of regional lymph nodes. Code these cases as 2 if no further dissection of regional lymph nodes was undertaken, or 6 when regional lymph nodes were dissected during the same operative event.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: SLNBx and regional lymph node dissection (code 3, 4, or 5) during the same surgical event, or timing not known.

section_path: Scope of Regional Lymph Node Surgery at this Facility
Coding Instructions
text: SLNBx and regional lymph node dissection (code 3, 4, or 5) in separate surgical events.
